name: Matsushima Biwako wa Kaizou Ningen de Aru.
original_name: 松島枇杷子は改造人間である。
source:
In the 21st century Tokyo suffers from terrorist acts set by modified humans. Disappointed by police ineffectiveness, a provincial town girl moves to Tokyo. This is a story about a girl and two modified humans who stand up to protect Tokyo from the the evil army.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
21世纪的东京饱受改造人发动的恐怖袭击。来自地方小镇的少女对警方的无能深感失望，于是搬到东京。这是一个关于一名少女和两名改造人的故事，他们挺身而出，保护东京免遭邪恶军团侵害。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
